{"reason":"Add a high-confidence gate and tighten change/exposure cutoffs to >0.20 and >1,000,000. V1 has 20 false arbitrations (FAR 0.714) despite recall 1.0; the stricter rule rejects all eight examples, including -0.428/1.3M at 0.66 and -0.428/0.69M at 0.91, while preserving recall >=0.8.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.2)
       (> inventory-exposure 1000000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
